sources.title_original: 基于AMD GPU的vLLM中的推测性解码
sources.summary:
A practical guide to speculative decoding in vLLM on AMD GPUs, covering draft-and-verify mechanics, MTP, EAGLE-3, DFlash, DSpark, configuration, tuning, and ben
A practical guide to speculative decoding in vLLM on AMD GPUs, covering draft-and-verify mechanics, MTP, EAGLE-3, DFlash, DSpark, configuration, tuning, and ben
A practical guide to speculative decoding in vLLM on AMD GPUs, covering draft-and-verify mechanics, MTP, EAGLE-3, DFlash, DSpark, configuration, tuning, and ben
TL;DR: Speculativ
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本文在AMD Instinct MI300X与MI355X上使用ROCm平台，实测vLLM中native MTP、Gemma 4 MTP、EAGLE-3、DFlash、DSpark五种推测解码的吞吐差异，指出其受草案长度、模型族与接受行为影响，并给出配置调优指南。

sources.title_original: I refused to train the AI that could replace me
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 一位作者拒绝训练可能取代自己的AI，却坦言不知为何退出；文章借评论区争论AI接管技能是否应受人类约束，援引欧盟禁止纯自动化人事决策，对比中国加速推进，反思个体与社会的应对空间。

sources.title: 我拒绝培训可能取代我的AI / I refused to train the AI that could replace me

sources.title_en: I refused to train the AI that could replace me
sources.title_original: I refused to train the AI that could replace me
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 工业社会学博士James Maisiri拒绝以时薪600兰特（37美元）训练AI授课与评卷——那是可能取代他的工作。他以南非47.4%的青年失业率为例，揭示AI公司正低价榨取非洲专家的知识。
